popup.title: Mandorcai's Mansion
popup.description: A mysterious manor in the [[Bloomridge]] neighborhood, believed to have been built by its namesake – [[tiefling]] [[wizard]] [[Mandorcai]], in reality, its origin was much more [[fiend]]ish in nature.

popup.title: Seskergates
popup.description: A tower of a manse of the [[Sesker]] mercantile clan, purchased by the eccentric Baldurian court-[[mage]] named [[Imbralym Skoond]] in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Bormul House
popup.description: The elegant three-story townhouse of yellow [[granite]], home to the Baldurian branch of the [[Amn]]ian [[Bormul Dynasty]].

popup.title: Hhune House
popup.description: The palatial manse home of the influential [[patriar]] [[Hhune]] family, relatives of the royal house of [[Tethyr]].

popup.title: Eomane House
popup.description: The estate home of the [[Eomane]] family that controlled the most elite [[perfume]]ry in the city as well as [[fish]] and lamp [[fish oil]] processing factories.

popup.title: Rillyn House
popup.description: The house of the [[Rillyn]] [[patriar]] family of '''[[Baldur's Gate]]''', built on wealth gained through adventuring.

popup.title: Vanthampur Villa
popup.description: Home to the wealthy [[patriar]] noble [[Vanthampur]] family in [[Baldur's Gate]].

popup.title: Ramazith's Tower
popup.description: The landmark tower built by renowned [[sage]] and zoologist, [[Ramazith Flamesinger]], sometime before [[1368 DR]]; it was purchased by the [[Athkatlan]] [[mage]] [[Lorroakan]] in  [[1492 DR]].

popup.title: Whitkeep Hostel
popup.description: A large manor that served a number of purposes throughout its existence; during the later 15{{th}} century [[DR]], a [[gnome|gnomish]] artists' commune resided within.

popup.title: Silvershield Estate
popup.description: The family home of the [[Silvershield]] [[patriar]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] – a massive grand complex nearly the size of an entire city block that offered little comfort and coziness to its inhabitants and visitors.

popup.title: Omduil's Manor
popup.description: Home to [[Omduil]], sage and seer for hire in the 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Jhasso Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Jhasso]] [[patria]]r family of [[Baldur's Gate]], part-owners of the [[Seven Suns Trading Coster]].

popup.title: Coran's Manor
popup.description: Home to the wealthy adventurer-turned-politician named [[Coran]], until his death in [[1492 DR]].

popup.title: Hullhollyn Estate
popup.description: The family manse of a prominent [[patriar]] family – House [[Hullhollyn]], that ran a sizable merchant fleet.

popup.title: Sashenstar Estate
popup.description: The home to the wealthy [[Sashenstar]] [[patriar]] family, members of the [[Merchant's League]], who owned shipping, mining, and textile operations.

popup.title: Shattershield Estate
popup.description: The home to the only non-[[human]] [[patriar]] family – [[Shattershield]], that was instrumental in building the city's [[Old Walls (Baldur's Gate)|Old Walls]].

popup.title: Vannath Estate
popup.description: The manse that belongs to the [[Vannath]] [[patriar]] family that fled to [[Baldur's Gate]] from [[Neverwinter]] after the [[Spellplague]].

popup.title: Oberon Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Oberon (family)|Oberon]] [[patriar]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] that owned the majority of the city's dry docks.

popup.title: Belt Estate
popup.description: The manse of the [[Belt (family)|Belt]] [[patriar]] family that built its wealth via the business holdings related to the sale and exchange of horses.

popup.title: Eltan Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Eltan]] [[patriar]] family that was connected to the founding of the [[Flaming Fist]].

popup.title: Ravenshade Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Ravenshade]] [[patriar]] family that dealt in [[ink]]s, [[dye]]s, [[gem]]s, and jewelry.

popup.title: Durinbold Estate
popup.description: The estate of the [[Durinbold]] [[patriar]] family that owned numerous [[sheep]] herds and was related to the nobility of [[Waterdeep]].

popup.title: Caldwell Estate
popup.description: Home of the [[Caldwell]] clan – one of the oldest and richest [[patriar]] families of [[Baldur's Gate]].

popup.title: Gist Estate
popup.description: The estate of the [[Gist]] [[patriar]] family.

popup.title: Vammas Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Vammas]] [[patriar]] family.

popup.title: Redlocks Estate
popup.description: The [[Redlocks]] [[patriar]] family manse, the clan that was rumored to have had an affiliation with piracy.

popup.title: Nurthammas Estate
popup.description: The Estate of the [[Nurthammas]] [[patriar]] family that dealt in supplying ships for long voyages.

popup.title: Whitburn Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Whitburn]] [[patriar]] family that owned a [[slate]] quarry.

popup.title: Provoss Estate
popup.description: The estate of the [[Provoss]] [[patriar]] family that faced hardships after dire cattle herd losses in the 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Portyr Estate
popup.description: The estate of a ruling Ducal [[Portyr]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Stelmane Estate
popup.description: The estate of a ruling Ducal [[Stelmane]] family of [[Baldur's Gate]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Linnacker Estate
popup.description: The home manse of the [[Linnacker]]  [[patriar]] that made wealth from [[gem]] mines in [[Tethyr]].

popup.title: Jannath Estate
popup.description: The estate of the [[Jannath]] [[patriar]] family that owned profitable [[copper]] mines.

popup.title: Miyar Estate
popup.description: Home to a family member of the [[Merchant’s League]] – the [[Miyar]] [[patriar]] family that controlled the caravan supply and repair businesses.

popup.title: Oathoon Estate
popup.description: The manse of the [[Oathoon]] [[patriar]] family that traded in [[wine]]s and spirits.

popup.title: Hlath Estate
popup.description: The home estate of the influential [[Hlath (family)|Hlath]] [[patriar]] family.

popup.title: Tillerturn Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Tillerturn]] [[patria]]r family of [[Baldur's Gate]] that owned the lion's share of the city's buildings.

popup.title: Dlusker Estate
popup.description: The home of the [[Dlusker]] textile [[patriar]] family, down on its luck in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Guthmere Estate
popup.description: The family estate of the [[Guthmere]] [[patriar]] family that owned many butcheries and tanneries.

popup.title: Home of Krammoch Arkhstaff
popup.description: The office and home of [[sage]] and retired adventurer Krammoch Arkhstaff in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Home of Ragefast
popup.description: The office and home of the well-respected sage named [[Ragefast]] in the late 14th century [[DR]].

popup.title: Highberry Home
popup.description: The manse home of [[Cora Highberry]] and [[Roger Highberry]] ''circa'' [[1492 DR]], and the site of their lavish [[wine]] festivals.{{approx}}

popup.title: Fauragates
popup.description: The mansion home of the reclusive moneylender Lord [[Erevvus Qwulthurr]] and his consort, magical [[tattoo]]ist, [[Valanthia Harvonth]] in the late 15{{th}} century [[DR]].
